# Slow Speeds and Traffic Congestion at Site S-TUN-004

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** capacity at `S-TUN-004`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct detector alerts and KPI deviations match the time window, and external events, changes, and maintenance have been checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-29 19:00 to 2026-09-29 21:04
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-29 19:00
- **Affected:** S-TUN-004

## Summary

A sudden surge in active users and downlink traffic volume at site S-TUN-004 caused high PRB utilization and latency, resulting in localized congestion and slow speeds.

Customers experienced very slow speeds and increased latency around site S-TUN-004 from 19:00 to 21:00 on 2026-09-29.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-29 19:00: Anomaly alert ALR-0037 starts, showing spikes in active users, traffic, drop rates, and latency on site S-TUN-004. [ALR-0037, ANM-000448, ANM-000449, ANM-000450]
- 2026-09-29 19:10: Warning alarm ALM-000674 for high PRB utilization is raised on site S-TUN-004. [ALM-000674]
- 2026-09-29 21:00: Anomaly alert ALR-0037 and KPI deviations on site S-TUN-004 recover. [ALR-0037, T7]
- 2026-09-29 21:04: Warning alarm ALM-000674 for high PRB utilization clears on site S-TUN-004. [ALM-000674]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-004 experienced spikes in active users, downlink volume, drop rate, PRB utilization, and latency starting from 19:00 to 21:00 on 2026-09-29. [T1, T7, ALR-0037]
- Sibling sites S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-018 showed normal baseline performance during the incident window. [T7]
- No external events, maintenance windows, or configuration changes occurred on S-TUN-004 or its parent components during the incident window. [T3, T4, T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **capacity** at S-TUN-004: confirmed. KPIs and anomaly alerts directly evidence a traffic and user surge overwhelming site S-TUN-004, causing high PRB utilization and latency without external interferences. [T1, T5, T7, ALR-0037]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-A: rejected. Sibling sites sharing the same fiber link and aggregation router (S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-018) showed normal performance. [T2, T7]
3. **bad_change** at S-TUN-004: rejected. No configuration changes were executed during the relevant window. [T6]

## Ruled out

- T3: No external events were recorded for region TUN during the time window.
- T4: No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-004, LNK-TUN-02-A, or parent nodes during the time window.
- T6: No changes were recorded on S-TUN-004, LNK-TUN-02-A, AGG-TUN-02, or parent nodes during the time window.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor traffic trends on site S-TUN-004 to determine if capacity upgrades are required to handle recurring traffic spikes.
